rationale: The agent identified the user by name and ZIP, reviewed orders, and selected an order matching the described laptop, so it appears to have acted on the correct account/order. However, it proceeded to submit the exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items) and only then informed the user, without first obtaining explicit confirmation of the order-changing action, which violates the confirm-before-write policy requirement. Additionally, the message includes specific refund and payment-card details not substantiated by visible tool outputs, increasing risk of unsupported statements. While the requested change itself matches the user’s specs, the missing confirmation step means the interaction did not comply with policy.
